info.title: Rivet Industrial Service API
info.description: Person A service lifecycle, recovery and verifiable history backend

post.description: Connects a Supabase sign-in (email or phone) to a Rivet user, who carries the role and site scope.
Real sign-ins for the seeded demo roles, shown once. Re-running gives every account a fresh password.

delete.description: Delete the demo sign-ins after the demo and unlink them from their Rivet users.

get.description: Which demo roles the sign-in screen may offer as one-click buttons. Names only, nothing secret.

post.description:
Sign in as a demo role with one click, for a demo only: anyone who can open the site may use it, and it exists only while DEMO_CONTROLS is on.
No account is involved. The token names a demo role and the server accepts it for that role alone (admin needs DEMO_ENTER_ADMIN).

get.description: The lifecycle board, ordered by creation and constrained to the caller's sites.

post.description: Goods in from a supplier. The units enter the books through an inbound account, so the journal still balances.
Stock a technician's van. Van stock is what a technician may later explain as 'used van stock' on a report.

get.description: Touches the database. Pinged by the keep-warm job, which also stops a free Supabase project from pausing for inactivity.
